svg.title: Nokime, la découpe arrondie, for dark surfaces
svg.desc: The Nokime symbol: a rounded block cut by one N-shaped knife stroke into two pieces, cream for the dining room and green for the kitchen. Wordmark « nokime » in Archivo Bold at 112 % width. Chosen by Gabriel on 26 Sept 2026. Light surfaces: #15170F and #3E6B1F on #F3F1E8; one colour: both pieces in one colour, the cut stays.
